title: SignedLinkIssuedPayload
description: Payload of the SignedLinkIssued event: access-svc issued the signed link for a SignedLinkRequested (INV-REQ-901, FR-AF.23, INV-AC-18216). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4). It carries no passcode, token, e-mail address or mobile number (OWASP ASVS V3).

linkRef.description: The link reference (form of INV-T-17803); never the link itself.

subjectReference.description: The requestId of masterdata the link was issued for.

purpose.description: The purpose the link is single-purpose for.
